source_inspections.origin_group: U.S. Court of Appeals for the First Circuit
source_inspections.evidence_extract: The First Circuit granted a stay only as to directions requiring fiscal-year 2025 notices under the 2024 structure and denied the rest. It found no strong showing of likely success on reviewability, vacatur authority or the arbitrary-and-capricious challenge, and noted that the government did not substantially address the district court's pretext finding.
